## Presentation

Esri Account Manager for U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, will be presenting a forward‑looking overview of Esri’s geospatial platform and how emerging capabilities can support modern project delivery across government and industry. 

The presentation will cover the following topics: 

What’s New in ArcGIS (2026)

GeoAI

Living Digital Twins
